bundle.longDescription: FlatForm is a slicer for 2D fabrication. Like a 3D-printer slicer, it takes a 3D model and prepares it for a machine, but it slices the model into flat parts for laser cutters, CNC routers and flat 3D printing, with joinery, numbering, nesting and DXF/SVG/PDF/STL/3MF export.
